news.title: Global chip-stock rout deepens into the US open; Nikkei sinks 5%
news.text: Chip and AI-linked names fell across Asia and Europe overnight and US futures were sharply lower pre-open, extending Thursday's selloff. Japan's Nikkei 225 dropped about 5%. On the watchlist, AAOI (-9.1%) and CIEN (-7.7%) are the hardest hit at the open; PANW, ZS, META, PLTR and NTAP are all down 2-3%+.

news.title: Anthropic (ANT) gives back part of its IPO-day pop on day two
news.text: Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 (above the $70-78 marketed range, ~$1.5T valuation) and opened Thu 19 Nov up as much as 34% before closing about 17% higher in the largest IPO on record. Shares fell further pre-open today, pressuring broader AI-stock sentiment and contributing to the Nasdaq-100 futures slide noted above.
